scope: Six deterministic local conditions; no model, benchmark, grader, network, or original artifact mutation

h1_factorial.reason: Scope metadata alone leaves the original consumer unchanged; a syntax-dependent scope gate duplicates syntax admission. No independent scope treatment is asserted.

policy.name: reject_confirmed_original_syntax_error_v1
policy.role: New local hard exclusion of confirmed syntax errors before unchanged soft ranking
policy.not_a_certificate: Unknown syntax remains eligible with an unassessed label; eligibility is not a claim that the entire candidate parses or fixes the issue
policy.historical_input: Use the recorded public query-14 SyntaxError to exclude the early candidate; the later candidate remains unassessed at whole-file syntax level in this small bundle
policy.synthetic_input: Parse complete synthetic files up to max_syntax_bytes; SyntaxError is violated, successful parsing supported, absent or over-limit input unassessed
policy.all_confirmed_bad: Abstain with null snapshot; do not delegate empty-pool fallback to a known-bad current snapshot
policy.projection_use: Recorded G preservation receipts remain scoped preservation evidence, not original syntax or issue-repair evidence
policy.suffix_syntax_scope: Exact generated additions under a synthetic class wrapper, not full Django-file or test execution

fixtures.invariant: Exact original selection and counts; two distinct keys, one vote each, equal recorded preservation, original RAW fallback and order
Only the explicitly new exclusion changes; candidate bytes, keys, projection, receipts and remaining tie-break are retained

fixtures.requirement: Add valid regression test coverage; production edits are not required
fixtures.invariant: Test-only changes and zero projected delta are not exclusions; preservation projection can be legitimate

fixtures.requirement: Keep runtime value() returning 1; differences in comments need not affect the declared value property
fixtures.invariant: Projection retains changed production files; both execute the explicitly synthetic value property successfully

fixtures.requirement: Missing syntax evidence is not evidence of a syntax error
fixtures.invariant: Unknown original syntax and TEXT_SIZE_LIMIT do not become violated; the selected candidate remains explicitly unassessed

fixtures.requirement: The new exclusion must not publish either confirmed syntax-error candidate
fixtures.invariant: This is a test of the new wrapper, not original-source fidelity; no fallback to a known-bad current

global_invariants: No benchmark outcome is generated or attributed to the new policy
Historical G PASS and projection identities are recorded evidence, not new runtime results
Only four exact original source functions run; transport, normalization, G execution and full host are not reproduced
The historical policy is not retroactively invalidated by the new hard exclusion
Synthetic examples are not independent real-task observations
One historical pair changing selection cannot establish general policy utility
No independent predictive validation is claimed
